description.en: Nothing is said about the task, or the answer is about something else.
Only a word or two touch the task. Most of what was asked is missing.
Some of what was asked is said, but at least one important part is left out.
Everything the task asked for is said, in short simple sentences.
Everything is said, and the speaker adds one useful detail that was not asked for.
No usable English words.
Single words or memorised chunks only, and the same few words come back again and again.
A small set of familiar words and phrases, with a lot of repeating.
Enough familiar words and phrases to do the task without much repeating.
Familiar words and phrases used with some variety, and one or two words beyond the unit's own list.
So many mistakes that the meaning is lost.
Many mistakes, including in the basic patterns of the unit. The meaning is often unclear.
Mistakes in the unit's basic patterns in about half of the sentences. The meaning can still be followed.
The unit's basic patterns are mostly right. A few mistakes do not hide the meaning.
The unit's basic patterns are right almost every time.
Nothing is connected. No sentence follows from another.
Separate words or phrases with no link between them.
Short sentences that follow each other in a loose order.
Short sentences in a sensible order, joined with simple words such as and.
Sentences in a clear order, linked with simple words such as and, but or because.
